# CycloneDX schema fixture

Unmodified official CycloneDX 1.6 JSON schema, downloaded 2026-11-04 from
https://cyclonedx.org/schema/bom-1.6.schema.json .
SHA-256: `1ebcb88a2c845ecb6ff7bee7aeabdff9422cb0347f3d6875b241bd444b7e098f`.
The schema declares Apache License 2.0; see LICENSE-Apache-2.0.txt.
Used only for offline standards validation in source tests. Publication uses the
stdlib-only strict canonical projection and never fetches schemas.

The referenced SPDX enumeration is retained unmodified from
https://cyclonedx.org/schema/spdx.schema.json (2026-11-04), Apache License 2.0.
Unreferenced signature schemas are deliberately not fetched by the offline tests.
